title: A Good Friend
text:
Anna and Tom have been friends since school. They live on the same street and often walk to work together. Anna likes to talk about books, and Tom likes to listen.

Last month Tom had a problem at his job. Anna helped him write a letter to his boss. Now Tom says that Anna is the best friend he has.

questions.text: Where do Anna and Tom live?
What did Anna help Tom write?
What can we infer about how Tom feels about Anna?
options: He trusts her and values her help
He does not know her well
He wants to move away from her

questions.text: Why do Anna and Tom probably spend a lot of time together?
options: They are close friends who enjoy each other's company
Their boss makes them work together
They have to share a house

vocabulary.definition: people you know well and like
to pay attention to sounds or words someone says
the person who is in charge of your work
a difficult situation that you need to solve

paragraph_translations: Anna i Tom są przyjaciółmi od czasów szkoły. Mieszkają na tej samej ulicy i często razem chodzą do pracy. Anna lubi rozmawiać o książkach, a Tom lubi słuchać.
W zeszłym miesiącu Tom miał problem w pracy. Anna pomogła mu napisać list do szefa. Teraz Tom mówi, że Anna jest najlepszą przyjaciółką, jaką ma.
